value.newDiagram:
[P] Canvas catalog / diagram record persistence
|
|-- CanvasCatalogStore (migration C destination)
|   |-- owns representation catalog + composition publication
|   |-- inherited by ProjectCatalogStore compatibility facade
|   |-- serializes save/projection/archive operations per store instance
|   |-- catalogRules validate expected revision and input history
|   |   |-- advanced diagram binding -> MERGE_REQUIRED
|   |   `-- other advanced canvas revision -> CANVAS_CONFLICT
|   `-- DiagramService.persist -> atomic canvases/catalog.json replacement
|-- Other parent-file owners use the same DiagramService
|   |-- MappingWorkspaceStore -> mapping-workspace.json
|   `-- DiagramChangeSessionStore
|       `-- mapping-change-sessions/<project>/<change>.json
|-- RevisionedDiagramService.persist / restore
|   `-- diagramPersistence storage adapter
|       |-- expanded Diagram -> diagram record reference
|       |-- diagram revision -> revision record reference
|       |-- history tables -> history record reference
|       `-- snapshot bindings -> diagramCheckpointId
|-- DiagramRecordStore port
|   `-- DiagramRevisionStore
|       |-- diagrams/diagram/<sha256>.json
|       |   `-- Diagram content + source context + jumps
|       |-- diagrams/revision/<sha256>.json
|       |   `-- revision identity / parent / nodeRefs / diagram reference
|       `-- diagrams/history/<sha256>.json
|           `-- revision references + checkpoint binding tables
|-- Parent files retain
|   |-- canvas composition snapshots + separate view state
|   |-- history head/baseline/past/future metadata
|   |-- opaque diagramHistory reference + checkpoint IDs
|   `-- compatibility exports and legacy saved-scene strings
|-- Write ordering
|   |-- validate expanded input
|   |-- persist referenced immutable records first
|   `-- atomically replace parent file only after dependencies succeed
|       `-- failure may leave unreferenced records, not premature pointers
`-- Read and compatibility
    |-- prefer canvases/catalog.json
    |-- if absent, read representations/catalog.json
    |-- hydrate references; validate hashes, histories and identities
    |-- missing/corrupt records are errors
    |-- old embedded content remains readable
    `-- HTTP responses / workspace exports stay expanded and portable

Next save writes new format without rewriting the legacy catalog.
SHA-256 storage addresses are distinct from diagram revision UUIDs.
No diagram-record garbage collection or automatic merge is implemented.
